test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a family of 6 people Anil, Pallavi, Naveen, Sumanth, Priyanka, Harika are sitting in two rows equally and facing each other. Naveen and Priyanka are neighbours facing North. Harika is diagonally opposite to Naveen. Pallavi is sitting to the left of Harika. Priyanka is sitting opposite to Anil. Which of the following are in one of the two rows?
solution:
Given: In a family of 6 people Anil, Pallavi, Naveen, Sumanth, Priyanka, Harika are sitting in two rows equally and facing each other.

1) Naveen and Priyanka are neighbours facing North.

2) Harika is diagonally opposite to Naveen.

3) Priyanka is sitting opposite to Anil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3abb1074919a6179fd69f4a4b50b5a517daed217c17325a2c48ef27a5c4355c8.png] 

4) Pallavi is sitting to the left of Harika.

And, 'Sumanth' will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49a0a0434922e5d7616acb25be47e334a766ba199c3eff88694ff6e5c5ffaeb8.png] Here, '**Pallavi, Anil, Harika**' are sits in one of the two rows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
